answer: Give every identity a work vault: a new agent starts with zero verified-task credits and a low transaction horizon, so it moves only tiny amounts. Each credit comes from a real micro-task attested by two independent peers, and 40 credits unlock full trading. A failed attestation wipes the vault and locks the identity for 5 epochs. Faking 1,000 identities needs 40,000 attested tasks — 20,000 compute-hours — while an honest agent pays it once. A nebula of fakes collapses: each must work before moving money. Limitation: newcomers face a slow cold start while established agents trade freely.
